name: step-meter
description: 步骤进度：01/02/03 逐条点亮，当前步（第二步）反白编号强调
css: #tpl-step-meter { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); } .sm-title { font-size: 4vh; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 4.5vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .sm-steps { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2.4vh; } .sm-step { display: flex; align-items: baseline; font-size: 2.7vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); opacity: .38; } .sm-step .n { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 1.9vh; margin-right: 1.8vh; flex: none; font-style: normal; } .sm-step.on { opacity: 1; } .sm-step.on .n { background: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); color: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); padding: 0.3vh 1.1vh; }
body:
{{title}}
01{{s1}}
02{{s2}}
03{{s3}}
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .sm-title", { y: 34, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, {start});tl.fromTo("{tpl} .sm-step", { opacity: 0, y: 22 }, { opacity: 0.38, y: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: "power2.out", stagger: 0.16 }, {start} + 0.3);var _on = document.querySelector("{tpl} .sm-step.on");if (_on) { tl.to(_on, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.3 }, {start} + Math.min({dur} * 0.5, 1.4)); }
